557. Matrix Neighbour Sum Replacement

70

Hard  Topics

Problem Statement:
You are given a matrix of dimensions M*N. Replace every element in the matrix with the sum of all its surrounding elements (immediate neighbours).
input_spec: Dimensions of the matrix followed by the elements of the matrix.
output_spec: A matrix with every element replaced by sum of its neighbours
